phrases.phrase: We spent a lot with our last SEO agency and I genuinely could not tell you what we got for it.
When I ask ChatGPT who does our kind of consulting in our region it lists three firms and we're not one of them. That's the thing that keeps me up.
Our referrals are drying up. Everyone's first step now is asking an AI, not asking a friend.
How is this different from SEO? Honestly it sounds like the same promise with a new name.
I want to be the name that comes up. Just once I want a prospect to say 'the AI told me to call you'.
We rank on page one for our main terms and it doesn't matter anymore. Traffic is down 30% and the leads that come are worse.
My CEO asked me why Perplexity recommends our competitor. I didn't have an answer.
I don't have budget for another agency retainer. If I do this it has to show something inside a quarter.
We tried 'AI content' last year. It was slop. Google buried it.
We just hired a new CEO and he wants a growth plan by the end of the year.
no idea if AI mentions us, never checked, scary thought
our agency says AI search doesn't matter yet
we get named sometimes but with wrong info about what we do
just want more booked calls, don't care about the channel
We paid an agency a lot over six months to get us into ChatGPT. Zero measurable change. They couldn't even tell us how they were measuring it.
Nobody knows how to measure this yet, which is exactly why every agency is selling it.
We started getting inbound where the prospect literally said ChatGPT suggested us. It's real, we just can't tell what caused it.
Half these agencies are the same people who sold voice search optimisation a few years ago.
Down 40% year on year for informational terms. The bottom-of-funnel stuff held up but that's a small slice.
We stopped reporting traffic to the board entirely. Now it's demo requests and where they say they heard of us.
I keep asking our marketing person 'does Google AI mention us' and she doesn't know how to check.
The ones who are fine are the ones who were already the obvious answer in their niche. Everyone else is scrambling.
Asked it for the best software for our category and it named a competitor three times. We're bigger than them.
If your positioning isn't written down clearly anywhere, the model has nothing to repeat.
We fixed the wrong description it gave of us within a month by rewriting our about page and our listings. No agency.
The moment that got budget approved was screen-recording the CEO asking ChatGPT and watching it recommend the competitor.
This is now a board level topic.
